items.direction: Adult woman with deep navy hair and whale-fin ears; half-lidded direct gaze, knowing asymmetric smirk, poised hand near hair ornament; tasteful navy evening outfit in luminous jellyfish aquarium. Landscape adaptation places her on the right with calm open left space.
Joyful closed-eye laugh while hugging a small whale plush; bright blue coastal afternoon. Wide version keeps the character and plush clear in a light seaside scene.
Clear wink and playful V-sign beside whale latte in an elegant seaside cafe; lively expression separate from the cute laugh.
Furrowed brows, pout and folded arms on a moonlit seaside terrace; preserve annoyed expression without softening into a smile.
Lowered eyes, blush, hands holding a scarf close in a snowy night scene; soft bashful expression, distinct from sadness.
Quiet, visibly sorrowful eyes while holding a letter beside a rain-covered window and harbor lights; restrained mood rather than neutral or smiling.
